title: LLDP Configuration
description: Configure the open-standard LLDP and verify neighbor information.
scenario: Configure the open-standard LLDP and verify neighbor information.

concepts.title: What is LLDP?
concepts.body: LLDP (802.1AB) is the open-standard discovery protocol, like CDP but vendor-neutral.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# lldp run
SW1# show lldp neighbors

concepts.title: Configuring LLDP
concepts.body: Enable globally with "lldp run". Change "lldp timer" and "lldp holdtime" values as needed.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# lldp run
SW1(config)# lldp timer 30
SW1(config)# lldp holdtime 120

concepts.title: Verifying LLDP
concepts.body: "show lldp status" lists LLDP state; "show lldp neighbors detail" gives MAC, platform, and port info.
concepts.code:
SW1# show lldp status
LLDP state: enabled
